dataset_description: A 14,062-row dataset of NBA regular-season player scoring rates spanning the 1996-97 through 2025-26 seasons. Each row describes one player-season using offensive statistics normalized per 100 offensive possessions, including two- and three-point field-goal volume and accuracy, free-throw points, assisted versus unassisted scoring splits, shot-mix and efficiency rates, putback points, blocked-attempt rates, and usage. Volume counts from the pbpstats totals API are scaled to a per-100-possessions rate basis; player name, team, games, minutes, and possession totals are dropped after preprocessing. The dataset supports usage regression and tabular synthetic-data experiments in which realistic semantic relationships among scoring variables should be preserved.

column_descriptions.Points: Total points scored per 100 offensive possessions from field goals and free throws.
column_descriptions.FG2M: Two-point field goals made per 100 offensive possessions.
column_descriptions.FG2A: Two-point field goals attempted per 100 offensive possessions.
column_descriptions.Fg2Pct: Two-point field-goal percentage on a 0-to-1 scale.
column_descriptions.FG3M: Three-point field goals made per 100 offensive possessions.
column_descriptions.FG3A: Three-point field goals attempted per 100 offensive possessions.
column_descriptions.Fg3Pct: Three-point field-goal percentage on a 0-to-1 scale.
column_descriptions.NonHeaveFg3Pct: Three-point field-goal percentage excluding heave attempts, on a 0-to-1 scale.
column_descriptions.FtPoints: Points scored from free throws per 100 offensive possessions.
column_descriptions.PtsAssisted2s: Points from assisted two-point field goals per 100 offensive possessions.
column_descriptions.PtsUnassisted2s: Points from unassisted two-point field goals per 100 offensive possessions, including putbacks.
column_descriptions.PtsAssisted3s: Points from assisted three-point field goals per 100 offensive possessions.
column_descriptions.PtsUnassisted3s: Points from unassisted three-point field goals per 100 offensive possessions.
column_descriptions.Assisted2sPct: Fraction of two-point field-goal points that were assisted, on a 0-to-1 scale.
column_descriptions.NonPutbacksAssisted2sPct: Fraction of non-putback two-point field-goal points that were assisted, on a 0-to-1 scale.
column_descriptions.Assisted3sPct: Fraction of three-point field-goal points that were assisted, on a 0-to-1 scale.
column_descriptions.FG3APct: Share of all field-goal attempts that are three-point attempts, on a 0-to-1 scale.
column_descriptions.ShotQualityAvg: Average estimated make probability of the player's field-goal attempts, summarizing how open or difficult the shot diet was. Values lie between 0 and 1.
column_descriptions.EfgPct: Effective field-goal percentage, which credits three-point makes more than two-point makes. Values can exceed 1 and are bounded above by 1.5 in this table.
column_descriptions.TsPct: True shooting percentage, a points-per-possession efficiency measure that incorporates field goals and free throws. Values can exceed 1 and are bounded above by 1.5 in this table.
column_descriptions.PtsPutbacks: Points scored on putback field goals per 100 offensive possessions.
column_descriptions.Fg2aBlocked: Two-point field-goal attempts that were blocked, expressed per 100 offensive possessions.
column_descriptions.FG2APctBlocked: Fraction of two-point field-goal attempts that were blocked, on a 0-to-1 scale.
column_descriptions.Fg3aBlocked: Three-point field-goal attempts that were blocked, expressed per 100 offensive possessions.
column_descriptions.FG3APctBlocked: Fraction of three-point field-goal attempts that were blocked, on a 0-to-1 scale.
column_descriptions.Usage: Player usage rate: the percentage of team possessions ending with the player's field-goal attempt, free-throw trip, or turnover while on the floor. Values lie between 0 and 100. This is the regression target.
